The '''2027 Paarl Royals season''' is the fifth season of the franchise in the [[SA20]].<ref>{{cite web |title=BETWAY SA20 SEASON 5 FIXTURES ANNOUNCED |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-season-5-fixtures-announced |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref> The team is captained by [[David Miller (South African cricketer)|David Miller]] and coached by [[Trevor Penney]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Trevor Penney appointed Head Coach of Paarl Royals ahead of 2025 SA20 season |url=https://www.paarlroyals.com/press-releases/trevor-penney-appointed-head-coach-of-paarl-royals-ahead-of-2025-sa20-season |access-date=3 August 2026 |website=Paarl Royals}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=SA20 FRANCHISE PAARL ROYALS ANNOUNCE DAVID MILLER AS CAPTAIN |url=https://www.paarlroyals.com/press-releases/sa20-franchise-paarl-royals-announce-david-miller-as-captain-for-inaugural-season |access-date=3 August 2026 |website=Paarl Royals}}</ref>
